title: Website About and Story edits save to the Space too

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-26: content blocks synced across Spotlight, Space page and website; follow-up to LIVE-1384

detail: Publishing the website now saves the About typed into its home page About section to the Space's intro (spaces.about) and leaves the section on the shared {{intro}} token. Publishing the Space page also saves a typed Story body to the Space's longer story (profileData.about). Sections that already carry a slot token, or sit on other pages, are never touched.

verify.evidence: Vitest share-about, promote-about, site editor and Space profile action suites pass; check:authz and the Space write-safety probe pass.
